units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:4">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>קרייה דש׳</he> the city of Shomron. Ib. I, 39ᶜ [read:] <he>הדא … מש׳ כפלחין הוא</he> the garrison of Cæsaræa, because the majority of them came from Samaria, are considered as worshipping observers (of the Calendæ and Saturnalia); v., however, <cite ref="O00250"><he>סוּגֵי</he></cite>.
